title: Ananias and Sapphira, Apostles Arrested and Flogged

questions.question: What was the sin of Ananias and Sapphira?
options: They sold a piece of property but kept back part of the proceeds and lied about it to the Holy Spirit
They refused to sell their property when asked by the apostles
They gave money to the poor privately instead of to the apostles
They worshipped the emperor and denied Christ secretly
questions.correctAnswer: They sold a piece of property but kept back part of the proceeds and lied about it to the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Acts 5:1-2 (ESV): "But a man named Ananias, with his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property, and with his wife's knowledge he kept back for himself some of the proceeds and brought only a part of it and laid it at the apostles' feet."

questions.question: Peter told Ananias that he had not lied to men but to whom?
options: God
The Holy Spirit
The apostles
The church
questions.explanation: Acts 5:4 (ESV): "You have not lied to man but to God."

questions.question: What happened to Ananias when he heard Peter's words?
options: He fell down and breathed his last
He wept bitterly and confessed
He ran from the apostles in fear
He fell into a three-day trance
questions.correctAnswer: He fell down and breathed his last
questions.explanation: Acts 5:5 (ESV): "When Ananias heard these words, he fell down and breathed his last. And great fear came upon all who heard of it."

questions.question: About how long after Ananias died did Sapphira come in, not knowing what had happened?
options: About three hours
About one hour
About twelve hours
The next morning
questions.explanation: Acts 5:7 (ESV): "After an interval of about three hours his wife came in, not knowing what had happened."

questions.question: What question did Peter ask Sapphira to test her?
options: "Tell me whether you sold the land for so much." And she said, "Yes, for so much."
"Did you know what your husband planned to do with the money?"
"Will you confess your sin before God and the church today?"
"Do you swear before God that you gave everything from the sale?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Tell me whether you sold the land for so much." And she said, "Yes, for so much."
questions.explanation: Acts 5:8 (ESV): "Peter said to her, 'Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.' And she said, 'Yes, for so much.'"

questions.question: Many signs and wonders were done among the people. Where specifically did the apostles frequently gather?
options: Solomon's Portico
The court of the Gentiles
The temple treasury
The Mount of Olives
questions.explanation: Acts 5:12 (ESV): "Now many signs and wonders were regularly done among the people by the hands of the apostles. And they were all together in Solomon's Portico."

questions.question: What did people bring out into the streets so that Peter's shadow might fall on the sick as he passed?
options: The sick and those afflicted with unclean spirits on cots and mats
Jars of water to be blessed and poured on the ill
Clay tablets inscribed with names of the sick
Garments to be touched by the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: The sick and those afflicted with unclean spirits on cots and mats
questions.explanation: Acts 5:15 (ESV): "so that they even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mats, that as Peter came by at least his shadow might fall on some of them."

questions.question: The high priest and the Sadducees arrested the apostles and put them in prison. What happened that night?
options: An angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and led them out
An earthquake shook the prison and the doors opened
The chains fell from their wrists while they prayed
A great wind blew the doors off their hinges
questions.correctAnswer: An angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and led them out
questions.explanation: Acts 5:19 (ESV): "But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors and brought them out, and said,"

questions.question: When the captain brought the apostles before the council, Peter declared: "We must obey God rather than..."?
options: men
the law
the temple
you rulers
questions.explanation: Acts 5:29 (ESV): "But Peter and the apostles answered, 'We must obey God rather than men.'"

questions.question: Who in the council advised the others not to kill the apostles, giving the examples of Theudas and Judas the Galilean?
options: A Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law
Nicodemus who had come to Jesus by night
Joseph of Arimathea who buried Jesus
A scribe named Eleazar the wise
questions.correctAnswer: A Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law
questions.explanation: Acts 5:34 (ESV): "But a Pharisee in the council named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law held in honor by all the people, stood up and gave orders to put the men outside for a little while."

questions.question: What was Gamaliel's key argument for not harming the apostles?
options: "If this plan or this undertaking is of man, it will fail; but if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You might even be found opposing God!"
"These men have done nothing worthy of death and have broken no Roman law."
"Let us wait for a sign before judging whether they speak truth."
"The crowd favors them and a riot would dishonor Israel."
questions.correctAnswer: "If this plan or this undertaking is of man, it will fail; but if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You might even be found opposing God!"
questions.explanation: Acts 5:38-39 (ESV): "So in the present case I tell you, keep away from these men and let them alone, for if this plan or this undertaking is of man, it will fail; but if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow them. You might even be found opposing God!"

questions.question: What did the council do to the apostles before releasing them?
options: Beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus
Imprisoned them for thirty days and confiscated their cloaks
Brought them before Pilate for additional punishment
Forced them to swear an oath before the temple altar
questions.correctAnswer: Beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus
questions.explanation: Acts 5:40 (ESV): "and when they had called in the apostles, they beat them and charged them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go."

questions.question: How did the apostles respond after being beaten and released?
options: They left rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the name
They wept and asked God to avenge them on the council
They returned immediately to the upper room to pray
They scattered to avoid further imprisonment
questions.correctAnswer: They left rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the name
questions.explanation: Acts 5:41 (ESV): "Then they left the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for the name."

questions.question: What did the apostles do every day after the flogging?
options: They did not cease teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ in the temple and from house to house
They only met in private homes for fear of the council
They sent letters to distant synagogues explaining the resurrection
They confronted the high priest publicly in the temple courts
questions.correctAnswer: They did not cease teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ in the temple and from house to house
questions.explanation: Acts 5:42 (ESV): "And every day, in the temple and from house to house, they did not cease teaching and preaching that the Christ is Jesus."

questions.question: Peter told the council that God exalted Jesus "at his right hand as Leader and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and..."?
options: "forgiveness of sins."
"eternal life to all who believe."
"the Holy Spirit to those who obey him."
"restoration for the whole nation."
questions.explanation: Acts 5:31 (ESV): "God exalted him at his right hand as Leader and Savior, to give repentance to Israel and forgiveness of sins."

key_verse_text: But Peter and the apostles answered, "We must obey God rather than men."
